classification.name: class_effects
classification.title: Selected classes: distributional separation
classification.caption: Effect = P(class value > other) − P(class value < other), including ties through the Mann–Whitney statistic. Positive means larger morphology values in the named class. Human contrasts use only galaxies with ≥2 answers for that question; other includes split outcomes. Zoobot top-class contrasts use valid prediction vectors. Some top classes are rare; exact finite sample sizes and ≥0.5 confidence sensitivity are in the companion table.
